added.member: type import: texture { sway clumps | tiers ["map.png"] }
added.summary: The cook cuts a 2D plant's texture into the parts og.Sprite.sway moves, cooked as `<id>#sway`: `clumps` for a broadleaf tree or a bush, `tiers` for a conifer, or the parts of a map image of the texture's size (one flat colour per part, clear where the plant stands still). Drawn at rest the parts are the texture, texel for texel.
